description_en: Queries the geolocation information of all gateways under the current user account
description_zh: 查询当前用户账号名下所有网关的地理位置信息
name: ListGatewaysGisInfo

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Data.description_en: The list of gateway geolocation information

AuthTypes.description_en:
The contract type of the gateway. Valid values:

HYBRID: Hybrid gateway.
SINGLE_CHANNEL: single-channel gateway.
STANDARD: standard contract gateway
AuthTypes.description_zh:
网关合约类型。

HYBRID：Hybrid网关。
SINGLE_CHANNEL：单通道网关。
STANDARD：标准合约网关

ChargeStatus.description_en:
The payment status of the gateway. Valid values:

NORMAL: The gateway has no overdue payment and is working properly.
ARREARAGE: The gateway has an overdue payment
ChargeStatus.description_zh:
网关欠费状态。

NORMAL：网关未欠费，正常工作。
ARREARAGE：网关欠费

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway is available

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID used by the gateway

GisCoordinateSystem.description_en: The coordinate system used for the gateway longitude and latitude. Valid values: WGS_84, GCJ_02
GisCoordinateSystem.description_zh: 网关经纬度所采用的坐标系统，可取值为：WGS_84，GCJ_02

GisSourceType.description_en:
The GIS source of the gateway. Valid values:

USER_INPUT: user input.

HARDWARE: reported by the gateway
GisSourceType.description_zh:
网关GIS来源，可取值：

USER_INPUT：用户输入。

HARDWARE：网关上报

GwEui.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway

OnlineState.description_en:
The online or offline status of the gateway. Valid values:

ONLINE: online.

OFFLINE: offline
OnlineState.description_zh:
网关的在线、离线状态。可取值：

ONLINE：在线。

OFFLINE：离线

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
